# Web Design Guidelines

Use this skill to review UI work after implementation.

Before auditing, fetch the current official guidelines from:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines/main/command.md
```

Then review the requested files or page against those guidelines, focusing on UX clarity, responsiveness, accessibility, interaction states, layout quality, and production polish.
